svg.title: A reader with x = 0 or y = 0 has conditional error 1/2 whenever it clicks; it cannot improve the case ε < 1/2. The least contrast in (25) occurs at an endpoint of the log-odds interval. Balancing its two endpoint distances gives the unique minimum possible worst distance w, proving (21). At the floor the optimal ratio obeys log r = −1 2 log(ξ−ξ+).
